page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a centred heading "EXERC. XXXVII.", a centred subtitle in capitals and italic below it, then the body paragraph; no margin notes; running head at top; catchword and gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.p: uofis[?] partibus delitescens ad neruorum o-riginem, instar uenti reptantis, pertingere sentitur. Quòd utriq; mirum non est, quum idem scorpionis ueneno, & torpedinis ta-ctu factum iri, certissimum sit. Hic autem piscis manui piscatoris torporem inducit, licet fune teneatur. Oculorum quoq; uelu[?] ti suffusiones, uitio stomachi interdum in-feruntur. Supereft tandem de ea tractare e-pilepsia,quæ à dolore uentris sæpenume-ro oriri solet. Causa eius frequens est coli-cus dolor, qui medicamentis quantumuis aptis non cedit. Non raro quoq;,& præser-tim pueris accidit à uermibus, qui depre-henduntur ptyalismo, & uermium ascari-dumúe excretione per os,aut aluum.
main_text.head: EXERC. XXXVII.

head.i: VTRVM PRIMARIÆ OMNES epilepsiæ curabiles sint?

main_text.p: Quæ[?] in primis ab innata imbecillitate cerebri epilepsia proficiscit, nunquam solui potest, præclariorum medicorum sententia, si ad uicesimū quintum annum usq; processerit: quandoquidé tunc habitum contraxit morbus, nec ætatis mutatio, quæ ad ficciorem naturâ uer-gere

page.notes: The first word of the body is partly hidden by the large Q drop cap; read as Quæ[?] with doubt. "uofis" at the top of the page is uncertain. "uelu ti" at the line end is read as one word with doubt. The last word, "gere", is the catchword; the final line of the paragraph is cut off at the foot and reads as the catchword. Printed hyphens are kept on the line-end breaks.
